A tile registry (tiles[])

A single modal renderer (openTile()), which is the perfect “router”

What’s missing is:

A shared Teacher Dashboard (single instance, whole hub)

A telemetry hook layer so every activity (MCQ now, games later) logs attempts consistently

A clean “module slot” inside the modal so some tiles can load real interactive games (fractions 20Q, etc.) while others stay MCQ
